exam_scheme.note: The Fellowship Entrance Test (FET) is a national single-window eligibility-cum-ranking entrance examination conducted by NBEMS for admission to 2-year Post-Doctoral / Post-MD/MS/DNB Fellowship Programme of National Board (FNB) and Fellowship Programme for International Students (FPIS) across accredited medical institutions and hospitals in India. The examination is administered as a Computer Based Test (CBT) consisting of 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 400 marks with a duration of 1 hour 45 minutes (105 minutes). Marking scheme: 4 marks for each correct response, deduction of 1 mark for each incorrect response (25% negative marking). The questions evaluate candidates on the core feeder specialty syllabus and subspecialty competencies. Minimum qualifying standard: 50th percentile in the respective fellowship discipline.
